name: Munea: Family AI Companion
subtitle: Voice companionship for family
promotionalText: Talk about everyday life, remember meaningful details, and stay connected with the family members you invite.
description:
Munea is an AI companion for everyday life on iPhone.

Talk naturally with a companion about daily routines, interests, and memories. With your consent, Munea can keep conversation summaries so future chats feel more connected.

Key features:
• Voice conversations that feel like a familiar phone call
• Reminders for medication schedules, appointments, and everyday tasks
• An invitation-only family circle for updates, messages, and shared activities
• Mood, wellbeing, and personal health records you choose to save
• Optional Apple Health access for supported health data

Munea is a companionship and lifestyle-reminder tool. It does not provide diagnosis, treatment, psychotherapy, or emergency services. Contact a qualified professional for medical concerns and your local emergency service for urgent danger.

Some voice and AI features use credits. Prices, renewal and cancellation terms, included credits, and purchased-credit conditions are shown clearly in the App and in Apple's purchase sheet.
whatsNew: Meet Munea with AI voice companionship, everyday reminders, family activities, mood records, and optional Apple Health access.
